title: Anadolu Efes crowned Euroleague champions in Cologne
description: Anadolu Efes - FC Barcelona 86-81 Anadolu Efes have won 2020/21 Euroleague crown. They overcame FC Barcelona in the title game in Cologne tonight. Vasilije Micic (196-G-94, agency: BeoBasket) came up with MVP performance scoring 25 points for the Turkish powerhouse. FC Barcelona looked the better side in the first quarter. The Catalan team opened a 22-15 lead after ten minutes of action. But Anadolu Efes counter punched in the second frame. The Turkish team ignited a 24-14 rally to ensure a 39-36 halftime lead. Anadolu Efes stayed red hot offensively in the third term. They poured in 26 points in the quarter and grabbed a 65-58 advantage heading into the final stanza. But FC Barcelona denied the deficit.
